d:
Two sisters meet a man.
Two sisters, Orpha and Rosalee, live an isolated life in a remote desert, cloistered in their own world. They live off the land and provide for themselves, and while their life is gritty and they work hard, they have never sought anything outside of it.
But then a man from the bank appears, claiming that their house is the bank’s and has never been paid off. The sisters have very different reactions to the presence of an intruder -- and different ways of coping with an outside threat to their home and life together.
